name: ANI Integrated Services Ltd
about: Incorporated in 2008, ANI Integrated Services Ltd operates in four verticals viz. deputation of manpower, operations and maintenance, project and consulting services, and detailed engineering vertical[1]
keyPoints:
Services Offered:[1]
a) Turnkey E&I Projects:[2]
Erection, Installation, Testing and Commissioning Services for Electrical, Instrumentation and Control
b) Operation and Maintenance:[3]
Company provides services for Day-to-Day Plant Operations, Breakdown Maintenance and Preventive Maintenance
c) Manpower Deputation:[4]
Manpower Deputation services include Construction Supervision, Engineering Design Deputation, Project Management Services, etc.

pros: Stock is trading at 1.17 times its book value
Company has delivered good profit growth of 35.8% CAGR over last 5 years
Promoter holding has increased by 3.23% over last quarter.
cons: Though the company is reporting repeated profits, it is not paying out dividend
Company has a low return on equity of 11.0% over last 3 years.
